parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.appointmentId||!b.actor)throw new Error('appointmentId and actor required');return[{json:b}];

parameters.query: WITH cancelled AS (UPDATE appointments SET status='cancelled',updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1 AND status IN('held','confirmed','rebooked') RETURNING id,resource_id,service_type,starts_at), ranked AS (SELECT w.id FROM waitlist_entries w,cancelled c WHERE w.status='waiting' AND w.resource_id=c.resource_id AND w.service_type=c.service_type ORDER BY w.priority DESC,w.created_at ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE waitlist_entries SET status='offered',offer_expires_at=now()+interval '15 minutes' WHERE id IN(SELECT id FROM ranked) RETURNING id,offer_expires_at;
